name: Pit
description: Tools for The Pit: hunt a player, loot sewer chests, fight in place and track kill streaks.

addons.AutoHunt: Chases one named player with the pathfinding bot: use .hunt <name> to start and .hunt stop to stop. Can limit KillAura to your prey and walks to where they were last seen if they disappear.
addons.AutoSewerChest: Finds freshly spawned sewer chests, walks to them with the built-in pathfinder, opens them and tidies your inventory afterwards (drops junk and duplicates, keeps the best gear in your hotbar). Can draw the path and the chests.
addons.FightBot: Holds a spot and fights for you: turns on KillAura, chases enemies inside the chase range with the pathfinding bot and walks back to where it started. Stops by itself if you are teleported away or respawn.
addons.AutoUber: Made for classic pit. Uberstreak fight bot: /oof at 400 streak, Tactical Insertion after each death, Self-checkout pants at a 5,000g bounty, sprint jumps to the densest crowd around 0 0 while steering around slimes, friends diamond chestplate players and sends player chat to desktop notifications.
addons.FastCake: Nukes the cake in the cake minor event
addons.KillTracker: Reads the server's streak broadcasts and shows a draggable panel ranking players by kills per minute. Hides the streak messages from chat so the panel replaces the spam.
